answers.prompt: The key to my heart is
answers.answer: Sending me a voice memo instead of a text. I will listen to all four minutes of it.
Every houseplant I own can hear me apologizing when I forget to water it.

goldFacts: I prefer voice memos over texts.
I have houseplants and sometimes forget to water them.

traps.text: I have 40 houseplants and a name for each one.
I own a fiddle leaf fig named Gerald.
I'm a plant mom who never kills anything.
